title: Passkeys screen has removing Option, adding bool, stale bool, requested_at, registration, ceremony Options and error
trigger: List, remove and create a passkey.
effect: Registration is registration + ceremony + adding + Parameters in-flight purpose scan; login (passkeys_login.rs) adds pending, ceremony, checking, config_requested bools.
fix: A Register enum (Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(options), Adding) and a Login enum.

title: BankCardLookup is loading bool + info Option for one lookup
trigger: Tap a bank card number in a message.
effect: loading and info are changed together by hand; a second tap replaces the lookup while the first answer is in flight and the purpose carries no number to match.
fix: Fetch<BankCardInfo> inside the lookup, with the answer keyed by the number or RequestId.

title: Star subscriptions list is loading + stale + mutating + error + offset bools next to an Option list
trigger: Open the subscriptions page, cancel one, refetch.
effect: Stages are kept in step by hand across star_subscriptions, _loading, _stale, _mutating, _error, _offset.
fix: Fetch<StarSubscriptions> plus a Mutation enum (Idle, Editing(RequestId)).

title: Wearable gifts and default icon lists are a list + loaded/failed bool pair, with is_empty meaning not loaded
trigger: Open the color dialog, chat appearance, or the photo builder.
effect: background_emoji_icons, profile_photo_emoji_icons (profile_photo_sources.rs:50) and wearable_gifts use empty-list plus a _failed or _loaded bool as stage; an empty answer from TDLib re-asks on every open, and load_wearable_gifts sets wearable_gifts_loaded=false before the request so a refetch hides a loaded list.
fix: Fetch<Vec<..>> per list.

title: Premium hub stages are many bool pairs: tx_loading/tx_loaded/tx_error/tx_request, gifts_loading/gifts_loaded/gifts_stale/gifts_error, premium_loading/premium, business_features_loading, premium_stickers_asked/loading
trigger: Open Stars history, gifts, Premium explainer.
effect: Each resource keeps loading, loaded, error and request id as separate fields reset by hand (set_star_transactions_filter resets four fields; open_received_gifts resets nine).
fix: Fetch<T> per resource plus a Paged<T> for the two lists.

title: Network usage is network_loading bool + network_usage Option; reset sets it None and refetches at once
trigger: Open Data and Storage, press Reset statistics.
effect: No dedupe: each open and each reset sends a request; two answers can arrive and the older fills the reset view; loading is a bool cleared by the answer.
fix: Fetch<NetworkUsage> keyed by RequestId.

title: Network usage is Option + network_loading bool + shared error string
trigger: fetch_network_statistics sets network_loading before the request; the payload and the error arm clear it; reset_network_statistics also clears network_usage by hand.
effect: Two fields (network_usage, network_loading) plus the shared error describe one fetch.
fix: network_usage: Fetch<NetworkUsage>; per-feature error fields instead of one shared error.

title: Network usage is Option<NetworkUsage> + network_loading bool + a shared privacy_data.error
trigger: n/a
effect: Loading, ready and failed are three fields; the error is shared with other privacy-data requests.
fix: `network_usage: Fetch<NetworkUsage>`.

title: Groups in common first page and next page share one purpose and are told apart by common_groups_paging.loading_more
trigger: Open a profile, scroll the groups in common list.
effect: RequestPurpose::GetProfileChats(GroupsInCommon) is used for both pages; the answer handler must read the loading_more bool to know which; paging{exhausted, loading_more} sits beside the Fetch list.
fix: Loaded{ids, next: PageState} like ProfilePhotosFetch, with the page request id in the purpose.

title: CommonGroupsPaging is two bools (exhausted, loading_more) beside ProfileChatsFetch
trigger: Groups in common: first page sets exhausted from its length; a follow-up sets loading_more; the answer take()s loading_more to decide replace-or-extend.
effect: See the two bugs on this struct.
fix: `enum GroupsPaging { More, Asking(RequestId), End }` stored inside ProfileChatsFetch::Loaded.

title: InviteLinkMembersState holds loading: bool next to error and request: Option<RequestId>
trigger: Open a link's member list: loading=true,request=Some; answer sets loading=false,error=None,request=None; error sets loading=false,request=None,error=Some. Three fields change together in four places.
effect: No bug today (answers are matched on `request`); loading and request can disagree if a path forgets one.
fix: `page: Fetch<RequestId>`-style enum: Idle | Loading(RequestId) | Failed(String), members kept beside it.

title: Playlist per user is loading bool + loaded bool + tracks + has_more
trigger: Open a profile with music, scroll, reorder.
effect: playlist.loading, loaded and error are changed in fetch_playlist and fail_profile_audios by hand; entry(user_id).or_default() creates a playlist entry for any user that is asked about.
fix: Fetch<Paged<Track>> per user.

title: Playlist fetch is loaded/loading/error/stale bools
trigger: The profile's saved music.
effect: loaded, loading, error and stale are set by hand in fetch_playlist, apply_profile_audios, fail_profile_audios and take_stale_playlists; an append failure sets error beside loaded tracks.
fix: Use Fetch<…> for the first page plus a separate more-page state, with Stale as a variant that the driver turns into Loading.

title: Proxy settings stage is loading + fetch_attempted + stale + mutating + error + pings map + proxy_ping_requests + SentStep{settled,refused}
trigger: Open the proxy box, add, edit, ping, use system proxy.
effect: Fetching and mutating are bools cleared in session_proxy.rs (lines 38, 102, 159, 164); pings are PingStatus plus a second map of request ids; system proxy uses SentStep with settled and refused bools.
fix: Fetch<ProxyList> with Stale, a Mutation enum, and a Ping{Checking(RequestId),Done} per slot.

title: SentStep holds its stage as two bools (refused, settled) beside an Instant
trigger: Code reading: system_proxy_tick sets settled=true then refused from a side channel; refused without settled is meaningless.
effect: Three valid stages (in flight, settled ok, refused at time T) encoded as four bool combinations kept in step by hand in connect/proxy.rs.
fix: enum SentStepState { InFlight { request: RequestId }, Done, Refused { at: Instant } } inside SentStep { step, state }.

title: Next-channel preload readiness is preloaded_histories set + pinned_messages key + has_purpose scan
trigger: Pull toward the next unread channel.
effect: Ready flags are the presence of keys in two session maps; preload_next_channel removes the preloaded entry before re-asking, so a second pull flips readiness false then true; nothing clears the preloaded history when the pull is cancelled.
fix: A Preload stage in the pull machine (Idle, Loading, Ready) per target chat.

title: Sponsored report is sponsored_report: Option + last_sponsored_report: Option, each drawn when chat id matches
trigger: Report an ad: flight, then outcome.
effect: Flight and outcome can both exist (picker and outcome banner drawn together) after a second report.
fix: One enum SponsoredReport { None, Picking, Sending, Outcome }.

title: Quick replies load state is shortcuts_requested bool + messages_requested set + error
trigger: Open quick replies.
effect: requested flags are reset by hand on a failed send, and by the error arm on a TDLib error (must be checked in both places); no loaded/loading/failed stage.
fix: Fetch<Shortcuts> and a HashMap<ShortcutId, Fetch<Messages>>.

title: In-chat search stage is split across pending_typed_chat_search, chat_search_debounce_token, search.chat_search.{status, generation, query, loading_more} and a session-wide single state
trigger: Type in Ctrl+F search, change sender, press next.
effect: The debounce token and pending Option live on the ConnectDriver while status, generation and loading_more live in Session; clear_chat_search_debounce, begin_query and restart_chat_search must be called in the right order; loading_more is a bool cleared by the answer.
fix: A ChatSearch enum in ChatUi (Idle, Debouncing{token,query}, Searching{gen}, Ready, Failed) owning the debounce.

title: Typed-search stage is pending_typed_search Option + search_debounce_token + search.query + generation, held by hand
trigger: Type in global search, change a filter, close search inside the debounce window.
effect: Four fields must agree; clear_typed_debounce is called from some exits (close_search, filters) but not from select_search_chat_open / select_search_message, which only call session.close_search.
fix: enum TypedSearch { Idle, Debouncing{token, query}, Sent{generation} } owned by SearchState and reset by close_search.

title: Paid public-post search depends on public_limits_exceeded bool + tabs.limits + query + scope
trigger: Search public posts until the free quota is gone, then confirm the Stars search.
effect: Stars spending is guarded by a bool that begin_query resets as a side effect; money safety rests on that hidden coupling (a repeated confirm is refused only because begin_query clears the flag).
fix: enum PublicPostsQuota { Free, Exceeded{query, price}, Paying{request} } so a paid request is bound to the query and price shown.

title: Recommended channels use recommended_loading + recommended_loaded bool pair
trigger: Open the Channels tab, fail, retry.
effect: Error clears loading only; loaded and loading must stay mutually exclusive by hand.
fix: enum Fetch { Idle, Loading, Loaded, Failed }.

title: SearchTabsState holds recommended_loading + recommended_loaded and loading_more + more_failed as separate bools
fix: Fetch<Vec<ChatId>> for the recommendations and a PageState {Idle, Loading, Failed} for the paging.

title: Read-date privacy stage is read_date_loading + read_date_error + read_date_show Option
trigger: Privacy screen: open, toggle read receipts, fail.
effect: Three fields set in different combinations by fetch, set, error and apply paths.
fix: enum ReadDateState { Unknown, Loading, Ready(bool), Saving{confirmed, wanted}, Failed }.

title: Settings screens hold their stage as bool flags: sessions_mutating, account_mutating, websites_mutating, default_auto_delete_busy, account_ttl_loading, connected_websites_loading plus *_stale and *_error Options
trigger: Open Security: terminate a session, delete account, set TTL, disconnect a website.
effect: Each flag is set before the send and cleared by separate error and ok handlers (error.rs, apply.rs, session_apply_ok.rs); sessions_mutating is shared by device login, terminate and both toggles, so one op's answer unlocks the others. Today every error path clears them, but one missed path sticks the screen.
fix: Per-resource enum (Idle/Loading/Ready/Mutating{request}/Failed) holding the request id, as FetchState already does for sessions.

title: Storage-limit seeding is storage_limits_seeded + storage_limits_seed_sent + storage_limits.chosen() across ingests
trigger: First Ready of a new account.
effect: Three booleans decide whether to send defaults once; correct today but must be kept in step by hand.
fix: enum StorageLimitSeed { NotSent, Sent, Confirmed }.

title: Gift Stars dialog stage is open + target Option + options Vec + loading bool + error Option
trigger: Open Gift Stars, pick a contact, go back, pick another.
effect: Stage is inferred from field combinations kept in step by hand (clear_target resets four fields).
fix: enum StarsGiftStage { Closed, PickContact, LoadingPacks{target, request}, Packs{target, options}, Failed{target, error} }.

title: StarsGiftState holds target, options, loading and error as hand-synchronised fields
trigger: Gift Stars dialog: pick a contact (choose_stars_gift_user), go back (clear_target), pick another
effect: Stages (contact list, loading packs for X, packs for X, failed for X) are encoded by Option target + bool loading + Option error + Vec options
fix: enum GiftStage { Contacts, Packs { target, packs: Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> } } so options belong to a target.

title: Gift Stars dialog stage is open + target + loading + error + options kept in step by clear_target
trigger: Any pick/back/close/answer sequence.
effect: Render branches on loading, then error, then options.is_empty(); choose_stars_gift_user send failure leaves target set with loading=false and no error (shows 'No options available').
fix: enum StarsGiftStage { Closed, Contacts, Packs(Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> with user) }.

title: Public-forwards stage is inferred from forwards.total>0 || !forwards.is_empty() plus a loading bool
trigger: Open statistics for a post with zero forwards.
effect: message_forwards_loaded is false for an answered empty list, so each fetch_message_statistics call while the statistics are in flight sends getMessagePublicForwards again.
fix: enum ForwardsFetch { Idle, Loading, Loaded{next_offset}, Failed }.

title: Panel set loading is selected_set_id + loaded_set_id + loading_set + set_request Option<(RequestId,i64)> + failed_set_id
trigger: Switch tabs and pick sets quickly.
effect: set_request is never cleared on success and is not reset when select_sticker_tab/search_sticker_picker drop the pending GetStickerSet (loading_set=false by hand).
fix: enum SetView { None, Selected(id), Loading{id, request}, Ready(id), Failed(id) }.

title: Batch install/archive progress is batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed and batch_pending kept in step by hand
trigger: Select several sets and archive them; one is busy or fails.
effect: Four fields mutate from the driver (reset, unsent items) and the reducer (finish_sticker_batch_item); no stage says finished or cancelled, and a new batch resets them while old answers still arrive.
fix: enum Batch { None, Running{pending: Vec<i64>, done, failed}, Finished{done, failed} }.

title: GIF panel stage is open + loading + loaded + failed + stale + search_mode + search_failed + search_loading
trigger: Open the GIF panel, search, fail, reopen.
effect: Eight bools and offsets are patched together in open_gif_panel, maybe_refresh_saved_animations and the reducer (failed also forces loaded=true).
fix: enum GifPanel { Closed, Saved(Fetch), Search{query, Fetch} }.

title: Live story join is pending_live_story_join Option + stories.live + calls.story_stream
trigger: Open a live story, switch to another live story, fail a join.
effect: join_live_story resets pending_live_story_join then leave_live_story/fetch_group_call/begin_live_story in several steps; a fetch_group_call error leaves live cleared but story_stream state as it was.
fix: enum LiveStory { None, Fetching{story, request}, Joining{..}, Playing{..}, Failed } in one owner.

title: Story viewers panel loading flag is set after the send by the driver
trigger: n/a
effect: StoryViewersState::loading/error/next_offset are kept in step with the GetStoryInteractions request by the driver and two reducer arms.
fix: Fetch-style enum with the offset requested, set in one place.

title: Story post flow is eligibility + check_error + outcome (+ UI check_sent/post_sent) kept in step by hand
trigger: canPostStory answer sets eligibility and clears check_error; its error sets check_error and leaves eligibility; getChatsToPostStories error also writes check_error. The UI frame_upkeep treats eligibility.is_some() || check_error.is_some() as 'answered'.
effect: The eligibility answer is not tied to the chat checked (purpose only), and the post-as list error shares the field of the eligibility check.
fix: One enum StoryPostStage { Idle, Checking{chat,request}, Eligible{chat,result}, Ineligible{chat,reason}, Posting{request,story_id}, Posted, Failed } and a separate Fetch for the post-as chats.

title: StoryViewersState keeps loading: bool beside error: Option<String> and rows/next_offset
trigger: Open the story viewers panel, let a page fail, press retry: get_story_interactions sets loading=true but never clears error
effect: loading and error can both be set; panel stage is derived from two fields kept in step by hand across posting.rs and session_stories.rs
fix: Replace loading/error with a Fetch-like enum (Idle, Loading{offset}, Ready, Failed(msg)) carrying the request id that asked.

title: StoryManageState: pending bool duplicates request Option
trigger: editStory / editStoryCover / setStoryPrivacySettings.
effect: pending is true exactly when request is Some; start, settle and fail_locally keep both in step. The slot is shared by the composer, the viewer's editors and albums, which read pending without a request.
fix: enum ManageCall { Idle, Pending{request, story}, Failed{story, error} }, and callers keep their own request id.

title: Viewers list paging reads StoryViewersState.loading bool beside next_offset
trigger: n/a
effect: story_viewers_scrolled loads the next page only if !loading and next_offset non-empty; loading is set on the driver's Ok send and must be cleared by the answer path by hand.
fix: A paged Fetch (Idle/Loading{offset}/Ready{next}/Failed) keyed by (chat, story, offset).

title: StoryPostState one-shot answers (eligibility, check_error, outcome) are unkeyed
trigger: Story composer check and post.
effect: The composer clears eligibility/check_error/outcome before asking and then waits for any of them to fill; nothing ties the answer to the canPostStory/postStory it sent.
fix: Carry the request id in a Checking{request}/Posting{request} stage and settle only from that answer.
